elements.label: Figure 4.3
elements.title: Comparison of t-Distribution and Normal Distribution Curves

t-Distribution, df = 10.tails: thicker (higher probability density in tails) compared to Normal Distribution and t-distribution df=30

elements.summary: This figure compares the shapes of the normal distribution curve and two t-distribution curves with different degrees of freedom (df=10 and df=30). It illustrates that t-distributions have thicker tails and lower peaks than the normal distribution, with the effect more pronounced at lower degrees of freedom.
